development_cohort.name: released_phys_twin_22
development_cohort.role: exploratory method development; all outcomes previously examined

information_boundary.selection_evidence: frame-zero geometry and visibility/motion-valid frequency strictly before split.test[0]
information_boundary.online_evidence: selected point measurements only at the three declared update frames
forbidden_for_prediction: object observations after the current update frame
confirmation-case outcomes for method or threshold selection
information_boundary.scoring: only frames strictly after an update; identity metric permanently excludes every selected centre
information_boundary.identity_null_frame_policy: omit a frame only from identity metrics when object_motions_valid leaves zero non-centre identities; retain it in Chamfer and all other supported metrics

measurement_policy.selector: deterministic farthest-point traversal starting from the smallest eligible source point ID
measurement_policy.online_available: object_visibilities AND object_motions_valid AND finite coordinates

claim_boundary: A pass supports recursive sparse-observation correction on a separate public PhysTwin cohort. It is not an open-loop or Deform360 state-of-the-art claim.
